title: Senior Financial Systems Analyst
description:
Title: Senior Financial Systems Analyst
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)
Duration: [Full-Time / Direct Hire]
Compensation: $71,200 – $124,500 + Benefits
Industry: Healthcare / Financial Analytics / Business Intelligence
What Makes This Role Exciting
TalentFish is casting a line for a Senior Financial Systems Analyst to join a nationally recognized healthcare organization. This role combines financial systems expertise, healthcare analytics, and business intelligence to help drive strategic decision-making across the organization.
This is an opportunity for a data-driven professional who thrives at the intersection of Finance, Technology, and Analytics, with the ability to translate complex healthcare and financial information into meaningful business insights. You'll work with enterprise stakeholders and play a key role in building reporting solutions that improve operational and financial performance. Position is for a senior-level analyst who combines strong financial acumen with technical reporting expertise and healthcare systems knowledge. The ideal candidate enjoys solving business problems with data, partnering across teams, and building analytics solutions that improve organizational outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to join a mission-driven organization recognized globally for innovation and patient care. Candidates with experience supporting healthcare analytics, financial reporting, and enterprise BI initiatives will be particularly well-positioned for success.

What You Bring
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Finance, Data Science, or related field
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in data analytics, Business Intelligence, or financial systems within healthcare or financial environments
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using:
    • Tableau
    • SSRS
    • Power BI or similar visualization platforms
  • Experience querying and analyzing data from EMR/EHR platforms
  • Ability to develop complex analytical and financial models
  • Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong customer service mindset and collaborative work style
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master's degree preferred
  • SQL experience preferred
  • Experience or certification in Tableau, Power BI, or related visualization tools
  • Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred
  • Experience with financial and encounter-based healthcare systems such as:
    • Cerner
    • Epic
What You'll Do
Financial Analytics & Business Intelligence
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards and reports using business intelligence tools such as Tableau and SSRS
  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement
  • Transform complex datasets into meaningful visualizations and executive-level insights
  • Support strategic planning initiatives through forecasting, benchmarking, and performance analysis
  • Develop advanced analytical models including:
    • Predictive models
    • Risk models
    • Optimization models
Data & Systems Management
  • Build and maintain scalable data models and reporting pipelines using SQL and related technologies
  • Pull and analyze data from healthcare EMR/EHR platforms and financial systems
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and quality across enterprise reporting systems
  • Determine system specifications and evaluate software/hardware compatibility requirements
  • Continuously assess and improve BI tools, reporting processes, and analytics capabilities
Collaboration & Leadership
  • Serve as a liaison between Finance, IT, Operations, and business teams
  • Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver actionable solutions
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional initiatives requiring financial and systems expertise
  • Support self-service analytics by creating documentation, data dictionaries, and promoting data literacy
  • Mentor and train junior analysts while providing guidance on reporting best practices
Compensation Information
The expected salary range for this position is $71,00.00 - $124,00.00/year depending on experience and qualifications. This role also qualifies for comprehensive benefits such as health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off.
TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity. The salary range provided is in compliance with applicable state and federal regulations.
This role requires authorization to work in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship. All offers are contingent upon the completion of a background check, which may include but is not limited to reference checks, education verification, employment verification, drug testing, criminal records checks, and any required certifications or compliance requirements based on the end client's background check policies and applicable laws.

title: Omnichannel Marketing Consultant
description:
Job Title: Omnichannel Marketing Consultant
Primary Location: Remote, must reside in the US, occasional travel required
Position Type: Direct Hire or Contract-to-Hire (flexible with long-term/FTE as the intent)

Overview
TalentFish is casting a line for an experienced Omnichannel Marketing Consultant with our premier client to support their life sciences clients across pharma and biotech digital marketing initiatives. This individual will help build, optimize, execute, and measure omnichannel commercial programs across DTC, HCP, sales, and payer-facing audiences.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role requiring a strong balance of strategic thinking, operational execution, analytics, and stakeholder management. The consultant will work closely with brand teams, marketing teams, agency partners, martech/adtech vendors, and internal consulting colleagues to deliver measurable business impact.

What You Bring to the Role. (Ideal Experience)

  • 10+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a meaningful portion in pharma or biotech brand or agency environments
  • BA/BS degree (at minimum) required
  • Demonstrated ability and desire to engage at executive-levels and get your hands dirty directly with operations team members and on your own.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing omnichannel digital marketing strategies for DTC, HCP, and/or payer audiences
  • Hands-on experience with one or more leading mar/ad tech platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Cloud, Veeva Vault PromoMats/CRM, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Google Ads/Analytics, Marketo, Data Platform(s) (Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.), Data Visualization Tools (Qlik, Tableau, PowerBI, etc.), DSPs (TradeDesk, PulsePoint, DeepIntent, etc.), CDPs, NBEs, Paid Social Platforms (Meta, Reddit, TikTok, etc.), Paid Search Platforms (Microsoft and Google), CM360, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with healthcare-specific digital channels and platforms (e.g., Doximity, ePocrates, Medscape, Client Health, Veeva CRM Approved Email)
  • Solid understanding of healthcare marketing fundamentals and regulatory requirements (FDA/OPDP, HIPAA, PhRMA guidelines)
  • Fluency in digital marketing KPIs, attribution models, and performance measurement methodologies
  • Experience working with CDPs, CRM systems, and audience segmentation strategies in a healthcare context
  • Strong analytical mindset—comfortable turning data into insights and insights into strategy
  • Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to present complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Highly organized with strong project management instincts and the ability to manage multiple client workstreams simultaneously
  • Collaborative by nature; you build bridges across internal teams, clients, and agency partners
  • Familiarity privacy-preserving analytics in a healthcare context
  • Experience supporting or leading digital transformation engagements at pharma/biotech companies
  • Understanding of launch excellence frameworks and the role of digital in new product launch planning
  • Prior experience in a management consulting or agency environment supporting life science clients
  • BA/BS degree required

What You'll Do. (Skills Used in this Position)

  • Serve as a trusted digital marketing advisor to pharma and biotech brand teams across DTC, HCP, sales, and payer-facing programs
  • Develop, support and/or execute omnichannel digital marketing strategies spanning paid media, email/CRM, web, and emerging channels
  • Translate brand objectives into actionable digital campaign plans with clear KPIs, measurement frameworks, and success criteria
  • Partner with client agency teams and mar/ad tech vendors to launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across platforms
  • Conduct in-depth campaign performance analyses and deliver actionable insights and recommendations to client stakeholders leveraging in-platform reporting, data platforms environments (SQL/Python), and data visualization tools.
  • Support the execution of campaigns with a working knowledge of the marketing technology stacks for life science clients
  • Identify workflow and process inefficiencies/anomalies and proactively recommend improvements to campaign operations and reporting
  • Develop client-ready deliverables including strategic roadmaps, campaign performance reports, and executive presentations
  • Foster authentic relationships with clients and agency partners that demonstrate value and build long-term trust
  • Ability to design, develop, and manage the implementation of complex solutions with existing and new technologies to enable new digital marketing capabilities.

Compensation Information
The expected salary range for this position is $80,000 - $140,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. This role also qualifies for comprehensive benefits such as health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off. TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity. title: Principal Consultant - Commercial Data & Marketing Technology
description:
Job Title: Principal Consultant – Commercial Data & Marketing Technology
Primary Location: Remote, must reside in the US and will have occasional travel
Position Type: Direct Hire or Contract-to-Hire (flexible with long-term/FTE as the intent)

Overview
TalentFish is casting a line for a highly experienced Principal Consultant focused on Commercial Data & Marketing Technology within the life sciences/pharma space for our premier client. This individual will serve as both a senior technical leader and client-facing strategic partner supporting complex commercial data and MarTech initiatives.

This is a highly hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise alongside executive-level consulting and stakeholder management capabilities. The ideal candidate can operate comfortably across architecture, engineering, agile delivery leadership, commercial analytics, and senior client advisory responsibilities.

The role will support a high-visibility life sciences engagement with opportunity to expand impact across additional pharma initiatives over time.

The Work — Day to Day
In a typical week, you will:
  • Lead the engagement’s overall delivery cadence — sprint planning, backlog grooming, stakeholder reviews, status communication
  • Own architectural decisions across the commercial data platform: ingestion patterns from media platforms (Google Ads, MS Ads, Meta, TikTok, CM360), CRM and sales (Veeva), pharma data vendors (IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Crossix), and the agency-side media plan
  • Stay in the platform — Databricks, Azure DevOps, the data model itself — for design work, code review, and the unblocking work that only the senior technical person can do
  • Reconcile campaign metadata across platforms using Claravine (or equivalent), and bring the media agency flowchart in as a first-class source of truth for spend-to-outcome reconciliation
  • Translate technical realities into commercial language for senior client stakeholders, and translate commercial outcomes into technical priorities for the team
  • Mentor and direct the existing team
The Stack You’ll Work With
Data platform: Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflows, jobs). CI/CD and source control: Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos, artifacts, branch strategy). Sources you’ll ingest, model, and operate on:
  • CRM and personal promotion: Veeva CRM / Vault
  • Adtech and media: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, TikTok, CM360, programmatic DSPs
  • MarTech and marketing automation: Marketo, with familiarity in Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Adobe Experience Cloud as a plus
  • Metadata management: Claravine or equivalent campaign taxonomy tooling
  • Agency-side: the media plan and flowchart as canonical artifacts for reconciliation
What Success Looks Like
In your first 30 days, you’ve built relationships across the client’s senior team, earned credibility with the engineering team by being immediately useful in code review and architectural conversations, and have a clear-eyed read on the engagement’s strengths and gaps.

In your first 90 days, you’re running delivery day-to-day with confidence, the client is bringing harder problems to you, and you’ve identified and shipped one or two pragmatic improvements to the platform that meaningfully move outcomes.
 
In your first 12 months, the client treats you as their trusted senior advisor for commercial data and MarTech, you’ve expanded scope or impact on the engagement, and you’re positioned to lead a second pharma engagement when the right opportunity emerges.

Preferred Experience
  • 10+ years in pharma/life sciences commercial data, marketing technology, or commercial analytics — in-house, at a consultancy or agency, or both
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, building, and operating modern data platforms on Databricks — Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, workflows, jobs. We are not looking for “I’ve heard of Databricks”; we are looking for “I’ve shipped on Databricks.”
  • Production experience with CI/CD on Azure DevOps — pipelines, repos, artifacts, branch strategy
  • Working knowledge of pharma commercial data, including personal promotion (rep-driven, Veeva-centric), non-personal promotion (HCP digital and DTC), and physician-level (NPI-linked) prescriber data
  • Hands-on familiarity ingesting, modeling, and reconciling data from major adtech and martech platforms including Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, TikTok, CM360, and Marketo
  • Working knowledge of campaign metadata management (Claravine or equivalent) and the operational discipline of reconciling media agency flowcharts and plans against platform-level execution data
  • Familiarity with major pharma-specific data vendors: IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Crossix/Veeva Crossix, Aktana, and similar
  • Enough fluency in omnichannel concepts — next-best-action, journey orchestration, suppression, frequency management, measurement frameworks — to design and operate the data infrastructure that supports them; you do not need to own the strategy
  • Strong agile delivery practice — sprint planning, backlog management, technical review, stakeholder rituals
  • The temperament to lead a senior consulting engagement: judgment under ambiguity, comfort with senior client conversations, the instinct to serve the work
What Sets You Apart
You’re a builder. You’re a partner. You take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You are quick to give credit and slow to take it. You believe pragmatism beats perfection in any environment where shipping matters. You’re comfortable in the technical weeds and comfortable in front of a CIO, and you treat both conversations with the same care. You have opinions, you hold them firmly, and you change your mind when the evidence calls for it.

Growth Path
This role starts as the senior lead on one strategic life sciences engagement. As scope expands across our pharma portfolio, the role can grow into a practice-leading position; building the clients’ life sciences practice as a recognized capability area, with the trajectory and impact that implies.

Compensation Information
The expected salary range for this position is $90,000 - $150,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. Competitive compensation aligned with experience, engagement model, and scope of impact. There is meaningful budget flexibility for the right person.
This role also qualifies for comprehensive benefits such as health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off. TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity. The salary range provided is in compliance with applicable state and federal regulations.

This role requires authorization to work in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship.
